listings.description: An exciting opportunity to join Leafio as a Quality Officer and play an important role in shaping the future of our pharmaceutical wholesale operations. As Leafio continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Officer who is passionate about maintaining high standards of quality, compliance and patient safety. This is an opportunity to be part of a business at a pivotal stage of its journey, helping to establish and develop our quality processes as we build a compliant, efficient and reliable pharmaceutical supply chain. Working closely with our Responsible Person and wider operational teams, you will play a key role in maintaining our Quality Management System, supporting regulatory compliance and ensuring that the medicines moving through our supply chain meet the highest standards. We are looking for someone who brings hands-on experience within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, a strong understanding of Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the confidence to take ownership of quality activities in a fast-paced, evolving business. If you enjoy working collaboratively, have a keen eye for detail and want to make a meaningful contribution to a growing organisation, this could be a fantastic next step in your career. We are looking for an experienced Clinical Pharmacist (Independent Prescriber) to join our growing London team. This is an opportunity to use your clinical expertise in an evolving area of healthcare, working alongside a multidisciplinary team to support patients throughout their treatment journey. Whether you already have experience in cannabis-based medicinal products or are looking to develop your knowledge in this specialist field, we offer the training and support to help you build your expertise while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives. What is the job? As a Clinical Pharmacist (Independent Prescriber), you will provide safe, effective and personalised treatment to patients with a wide range of clinical needs. Working closely with our multidisciplinary team, you will be responsible for clinically reviewing prescriptions, prescribing appropriate treatments and providing expert clinical guidance to patients and colleagues. You will also contribute to the development of clinical pathways, support patient and staff education and play an important role in maintaining the highest standards of clinical care. This is a hybrid position based at our King's Cross office in London, requiring three days on site and two days working remotely. Please note you will be required to work 1 Saturday per month onsite, for which a day in lieu will be given. What will you be doing? Clinically check and review cannabis-based medicinal product (CBPM) prescriptions to ensure safety, accuracy and appropriateness. Prescribe medicines as an Independent Prescriber, tailoring treatment to individual patient needs. Provide expert clinical guidance to patients and prescribers on treatment options. Maintain accurate and comprehensive patient records in accordance with GPhC standards. Support

listings.description: Are you an experienced doctor with a passion for developing others and delivering exceptional patient care? At Montu, we are looking for a Medical Team Lead to join our growing Clinical team, combining clinical practice with the opportunity to lead, mentor and develop a team of doctors. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys supporting others, has experience providing clinical guidance and supervision, and is confident in building strong working relationships with clinicians and consultants. You will play a key role in supporting the professional development of our Junior Clinical Fellows (JCFs), helping them build confidence, develop greater clinical autonomy and deliver safe, high-quality patient care. As we continue to grow, this is an opportunity to bring your clinical expertise and leadership skills into an evolving area of healthcare, helping to shape and support the next generation of clinicians while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives. What is the job? As a Medical Team Lead, you will provide day-to-day leadership, support and guidance to a team of clinicians, ensuring they are well-supervised, well-supported, and progressing safely towards greater clinical autonomy. You will act as the primary link between clinicians and consultants, coordinating supervision, escalation pathways, and feedback loops so that patient care stays safe and consistent. You will combine your own clinical practice with people leadership, taking ownership of fellow development, consultant engagement, governance, and training within your team, while working alongside other Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the wider service. You will be the first point of contact for JCF’s requiring guidance on professional or personal development and appraisal or revalidation. You will also act as a trusted contact for consultants raising concerns about supervision and workload. What will you be doing? Clinician Line Management Act as the named line manager

listings.title: Database Engineer I
listings.description:
Looking to take the next step in your database engineering career?


Want to join one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work?

 

At AXS, we're looking for a Database Engineer to help build and support the data platforms that power our products and services. You'll work with a range of modern database technologies, designing scalable solutions, improving performance, automating processes, and helping teams make the most of their data.

 

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to work in a collaborative, cloud-focused environment.

 

 

What You'll Be Doing

 

Database Design & Development

  • Design, build and maintain relational and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Aurora and MongoDB.
  • Develop scalable, reliable database solutions that support business and product goals.

 

Automation & DevOps

  • Integrate database deployments into CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, migrations and releases.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.

 

Performance & Reliability

  • Optimise queries, indexes and database performance to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Support high availability, backup, replication and disaster recovery strategies.

 

Monitoring & Security

  • Implement monitoring, alerting and logging to maintain database health and performance.
  • Apply security best practices, including encryption, access controls and compliance requirements.

listings.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
listings.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets. Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées. Missions principales Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %) Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables Prototypage rapide (15 %) Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D

listings.title: Software Engineer, ML Ops and Platform
listings.description: About the Company: Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet. World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate. Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI. TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine , highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive . The New York Times , Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100 . Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event. Define how Graphcore tests complex hardware before it reaches production and the field.

As Principal Board Test Engineer, you will lead advanced manufacturing test strategy for complex Circuit Board Assemblies. You will shape how Graphcore improves defect coverage, diagnostic resolution and production quality.

Your work will influence products, test architectures and manufacturing partners. You will define methods, evaluation criteria and technical approaches that help PTD move faster with confidence.

This is a senior technical role with real ownership. You will set direction, mentor engineers and help Graphcore build stronger test capability for future products.

The Team and Culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects, diagnoses and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and full systems. The team works close to design, manufacturing, silicon, software and systems engineering.

Work moves through hands-on investigation, clear technical judgement and direct ownership. You will be expected to act fast, speak up and take responsibility for test strategy decisions.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, design intent and manufacturing reality. You will help the team think big, challenge assumptions and raise engineering standards across disciplines.

Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. listings.title: Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
listings.description: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations. Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. Requirements What You’ll Do Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision. As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

listings.description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).

listings.title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering Engineer
listings.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI. You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks.
